description:
Execution boundary: planning approved; this issue does not authorize commits, pushes, merges, upstream publication, GitHub comments, live WhatsApp access, or real messages. Revalidate current source/Git state before implementation. Preserve unrelated work, including the already-edited docs/architecture.md. Track this work in the ZAQ Beadwork store even when files belong to the sibling package; do not initialize another store.
Read AGENTS.md in the affected repository. For ZAQ read docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md plus the domain policies listed below. Read module documentation before editing. Source navigation uses Serena with bounded fallback if unavailable. Record test results honestly; plan approval is not completed-feature UX approval. Follow repository validation owners; no assertion weakening or unrelated refactors. Existing test changes outside the specifically approved contracts need human approval.

Required domain policies: docs/services/engine.md; docs/services/channels.md linked-device contract; docs/services/system-config.md secret persistence.

Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add:
ZAQ owner: lib/zaq/engine/linked_device_confirmation.ex; public Action lib/zaq/engine/actions/confirm_linked_device.ex remains the trusted boundary. Keep only the normalized input %{attempt_id, provider, account: %{external_id, display_name}, credentials, owner_id}. Remove the identity.phone_number/records save clause, WhatsApp regex/hardcoded provider, legacy_identity argument and account_identity writes. Remove obsolete provider-specific retry matching only after confirming all production callers and record writers; the current legacy writer already writes normalized account. Do not invent a migration or erase historical records; escalate evidence of account_identity-only production data. Existing UI fallback reads may stay if needed for display compatibility; do not broaden cleanup into unrelated UI migration.
Preserve exact provider/owner/account retry identity, advisory-lock serialization, all-or-nothing connector + encrypted credentials creation, batch mutation notifications, reply policy defaults, and runtime activation after commit. Confirm action must derive owner from current authorized actor. Phone number remains account.external_id; display name remains account.display_name. Name absent still falls back to phone. Do not require a name or alter QR/provider behavior.
Update test/zaq/engine/linked_device_confirmation_test.exs and legacy fixtures in test/zaq/channels/linked_device/connector_disable_test.exs and any confirmed callers. Scan for additional callers before deletion.
APPROVAL: user agreed to normalized-only contract and fixture/test changes in this conversation ("okay agree but ... still ... name and phone number right?"); preservation of phone/name was explicitly confirmed. Replace Engine phone-specific validation coverage with normalized invalid-input and legacy-request rejection coverage; retain provider identity guarantees at the adapter boundary.

Tests to add before implementation:
Write focused regressions before production edits: normalized WhatsApp phone/name round trip including display-name absence; duplicate confirmation after response loss; changed provider/owner/account rejected; invalid normalized account/provider/attempt and missing owner/credentials; old input rejected; oversized/bad credential batch rolls back all writes; retained reply policy and notification count. Use non-WhatsApp provider to prove generic Engine ownership. Review existing adapter identity tests and add missing phone/unavailable-identity cases in the package, never move validation back to Engine. Property coverage for malformed input/idempotence where appropriate. Immediate unit/integration/component tests; any expanded browser journey belongs to existing zaq-0l7.8 after zaq-0l7.7.

Branches/paths validated:
Normalized success/retry/conflict, absent optional name, malformed/legacy input, storage rollback, permission rejection, provider-neutral persistence.

Mocking plan:
Real Repo/Connect mutations and encrypted fixture storage; only external transport is stubbed. Deterministic account fixtures and isolated DB; no shared application config mutation.

Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content:
Update module contracts and affected paragraphs in docs/services/engine.md and docs/services/channels.md after code matches them; read docs/documentation.md first. Record precise approved fixture/assertion changes and results in this issue.

Action reuse assessment:
Decision: extend/simplify LinkedDeviceConfirmation while reusing ConfirmLinkedDevice, ChannelConfig.create, Connect.credential_document(:bind/:put_many), and canonical Connect mutations. Existing adapter Pairing.account/1 and shared PairingSession.persistence_request already supply normalized values; do not create a second identity translator. Credential save alone cannot replace atomic connector creation plus attempt-scoped idempotence. Inputs/output/errors remain normalized request -> {:ok, config} / domain error; trusted confidential Engine runtime hop and Jido.Exec.run remain. Consumer is adapter pairing, never a newly exposed tool/workflow. Tests prove same persistence path across providers and no duplicate writes.

comments.text: Implementation authorized by user: start implementing. Context analysis: Engine LinkedDeviceConfirmation owns transactional connector+document persistence, not provider identity. Adapter shared pairing -> trusted ConfirmLinkedDevice -> save(normalized) -> ChannelConfig/Connect is the sole production path; direct legacy callers found in Engine and connector-disable tests only. Repo owns durable state; adapter owns runtime/QR identity. Invariants: atomic writes, attempt/provider/owner/account-scoped replay, no startup in transaction, phone/name retained, no duplicate notifications. Existing tests cover replay/rollback/policy; new tests cover normalized phone/name, legacy rejection, malformed generic input and property rejection. No account_identity-only writer found; no migration planned. Existing docs edit is this session point 6 and is explicitly preserved. Context execution works; automatic hooks unavailable; Serena symbol lookup empty, targeted fallback used.

Completed normalized-only confirmation and approved fixture changes. Regression red: legacy valid phone snapshot was wrongly saved; green after removal. Phone/display_name round trip and nil-name fallback verified; malformed generic input property added. Focused Engine/real Channels disable/document suites: 31 tests + 4 properties pass. mix q passes after rebuilding stale generated Expo/Earmark parser caches; no source dependency changes. git diff --check passes. Existing QR/live-provider behavior was not tested against a real account. All changes local, no commit/publication.
